$comment: The engine inputs that produce the shipped palette.
Until this file existed, the palette was not reproducible from the repo:
the seeds were entered interactively in the Harmoni Figma plugin and only
the OUTPUT was ever committed (packages/tokens/src/palette.json, and the
emitted tokens.css). That means nobody could regenerate the ramps from
source, and no CI check could tell you whether the committed palette still
Each seed is the ramp's own step 500. That is not a convention this file
invents — harmoni-core's generate_pair documents it directly: 'Both share
the brand colour at step 500.' The ramp-audit example verifies the claim
per ramp rather than assuming it, and reports any seed that fails to
Regenerate the audit with:  cargo run -p harmoni-core --example ramp-audit
or run the 'Harmoni ramp audit' workflow and download the artefact.
